technique_name: Construct an argument for why people should adopt plant-based diets
description: Adopting a plant-based diet is beneficial for a multitude of reasons. First, a plant-based diet has been proven to reduce the risk of developing chronic diseases such as Type 2 Diabetes, coronary heart disease, and certain cancers. Additionally, a plant-based diet requires fewer resources from the environment such as water, land, and organic waste.
